infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: SoS Partner shares your location with dispatch and customers while you're online so jobs can be routed to you.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: SoS Partner can keep sharing your location in the background while you're online for a job, so the customer can track you.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: SoS Partner uses your camera to capture KYC documents for verification.
